# gamjagoon-skills-pack

> A public Codex workflow pack that a coding agent can install when the user says
> "gamjagoon-skills-pack 설치해줘" or "install gamjagoon-skills-pack".

Canonical repository: https://github.com/gamjagoon/gamjagoon-skills-pack

## Install for the user

- [Agent installation guide](https://github.com/gamjagoon/gamjagoon-skills-pack/blob/main/INSTALL.md): Keep the user's original folder as the target, obtain uv if missing, execute the complete setup and read the installed instructions.
- [README](https://github.com/gamjagoon/gamjagoon-skills-pack/blob/main/README.md): Korean usage guide and optional manual commands.
- [Keyboard profile](https://github.com/gamjagoon/gamjagoon-skills-pack/blob/main/docs/keyboard.ko.md): Project-local Enter newline and Alt+Enter submit for Codex CLI.

The user does not need to memorize installer commands. Setup installs the original
180-minute workflow and six project-local Sol/Luna roles, not external skills or another AI provider. It does not upload
project contents or alter global Codex configuration. This file is a plain-text
documentation entrypoint; it does not imply automatic discovery by every agent.
